alt: Branches of the internal iliac artery in the male pelvis - obturator, superior and inferior vesical, middle rectal, internal pudendal and inferior gluteal from the anterior trunk, lateral sacral and superior gluteal from the posterior trunk, with the bladder, prostate and rectum for orientation.
